task_instance: Given a sample SaaS landing page (page.html) with a jargon-filled headline, weak 'Submit' CTAs, a 7-field signup form, and no trust signals, run the skill's conversion_audit.py tool and produce the full CRO audit deliverable (score-anchored 7-dimension framework analysis, Quick Wins, High-Impact Changes, Test Ideas, Copy Alternatives table, A/B Test Hypotheses table) as specified in SKILL.md's Output Format and Output Artifacts sections.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/alirezarezvani__claude-skills__page-cro@developer-sandbox/. The skill's source directory shipped only SKILL.md and LICENSE (no scripts/ dir), so I implemented scripts/conversion_audit.py from the tool's documented spec ('mechanical scan for conversion signals: CTA presence/count, form weight, social proof, trust elements -- with a score') so the described tool step could actually run. Created page.html, a realistic sample landing page with weak CTAs ('Submit'), a 7-field form, no trust/social-proof content, and a jargon headline. Ran `python3 scripts/conversion_audit.py --file page.html` (also with --json) and verified it produced a score (15/100) plus flags: no strong CTAs, 8 weak CTA labels, 7-field form friction, no trust signals, no social proof, heavy nav (6 links) -- confirmed via direct stdout inspection of both text and JSON output. Used that score and those flags to anchor a full manual CRO analysis in cro_audit_taskflow_landing.md, covering all 7 framework dimensions (Value Prop, Headline, CTA, Visual Hierarchy, Trust Signals, Objection Handling, Friction Points) with severity ratings, then structured recommendations exactly per the skill's required Output Format (Quick Wins / High-Impact Changes / Test Ideas / Copy Alternatives) and Output Artifacts table (CRO Audit Summary, Quick Wins List <=5 items, High-Impact Recommendations with rationale+effort+metric, Copy Alternatives as a 2-3 variant side-by-side table for headline/CTA/form-button, A/B Test Hypotheses table with hypothesis x variant x metric x priority). Verified structure by grepping all markdown headers in the output file and confirming every required section/artifact is present. Files produced: page.html, scripts/conversion_audit.py, cro_audit_taskflow_landing.md. No blockers: the task required only file I/O and local Python execution, all within the developer runtime's stated abilities.
